WITH cust_total AS (
  SELECT c.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total
  FROM customers c JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND ym.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
  GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
), minv AS (
  SELECT Segment, MIN(total) AS m FROM cust_total GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT ct.Segment, MIN(ct.total) AS min_total, COUNT(*) AS num_tied, SUM(ct.total) AS total_per_year
FROM cust_total ct JOIN minv ON ct.Segment = minv.Segment AND ct.total = minv.m
GROUP BY ct.Segment

WITH cust_total AS (
  SELECT c.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total
  FROM customers c JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND ym.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
  GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
), minv AS (
  SELECT Segment, MIN(total) AS avg FROM cust_total GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT
  MAX(CASE WHEN Segment='SME' THEN avg END) - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment='LAM' THEN avg END) AS SME_minus_LAM,
  MAX(CASE WHEN Segment='LAM' THEN avg END) - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment='KAM' THEN avg END) AS LAM_minus_KAM,
  MAX(CASE WHEN Segment='KAM' THEN avg END) - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment='SME' THEN avg END) AS KAM_minus_SME
FROM minv
